items.source: This interface is mainly intended for framework usage. Application code should prefer the use of the EntityManager.getDelegate() method to access native functionality of the underlying resource.
items.translation: 该接口主要用于框架使用。应用程序代码应优先使用 `EntityManager.getDelegate()` 方法来访问底层资源的原生功能。

items.source:
In case of an extended EntityManager, this will be the associated
raw EntityManager.
items.translation: 在扩展的 EntityManager 情况下，这将是关联的原始 EntityManager。

items.source:
In case of a shared ("transactional") EntityManager, this will be
the raw EntityManager that is currently associated with the transaction.
Outside a transaction, an IllegalStateException will be thrown.
items.translation: 在共享（“事务性”）EntityManager 的情况下，这将是当前与事务关联的原始 EntityManager。如果在事务外部，将抛出 IllegalStateException。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if no underlying EntityManager is available
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果不可用底层 EntityManager
底层原始 EntityManager（永远不为null）

items.source: Return the underlying EntityManager that this proxy will delegate to.
items.translation: 返回该代理将委托其操作的底层 EntityManager。
